claim: Lazy decay and event-routed active execution reduce audited algorithmic work relative to a dense-equivalent implementation while preserving target behavior in fixed sparse workloads.
non_claims: No use of historical exploratory H5 results as evidence or parameter selection.

runtime_binding.notes: The H5 candidate/comparator/workload/counter/scorer/preserver use Python stdlib plus the bound SparkBrain source only. Pytest and Ruff are readiness tooling, not scientific runtime dependencies.

candidate.name: sparkbrain_event_routed_lazy
candidate.semantics: Current SparkBrain queued-event execution, lazy per-Spark closed-form decay on touch, active outgoing-edge fanout on firing, and current dense eligibility-decay loop unchanged.

comparator.name: sparkbrain_dense_equivalent
comparator.semantics: Same graph, state equations, thresholds, decay, events, seeds, precision and output semantics as candidate; additionally materializes every Spark and evaluates every graph edge at every queued event before the same event transition.

sparse_primary.aggregation: equal weight across all family-size-activity strata within each seed, then equal weight across seeds

dense_control.role: diagnostic only; excluded from primary sparse PASS/FAIL statistic

dev_only_validation.allowed_use: mechanical equivalence and counter-invariant validation only; no threshold, workload, margin or statistic selection

audited_work.metric: unit-weight sum of named primitive algorithmic actions
audited_work.notes: Current SparkBrain eligibility decay already touches every edge per event and is counted on both sides. Queue and fanout bookkeeping are not omitted from the candidate. No hardware timing or energy surrogate enters the primary metric.

primary_statistic.seed_level_statistic: equal-weight mean across all sparse family-size-activity strata
primary_statistic.multiplicity: single primary statistic; activity-level reductions are deterministic gate summaries, other cell-level analyses descriptive only

decision_rule.pass: All quality guards pass; primary 95% CI lower bound >= 0.20; and each sparse activity-fraction mean work reduction >= 0.10.
decision_rule.fail: All quality guards pass and either primary 95% CI upper bound <= 0.05 or every sparse activity-fraction mean work reduction <= 0.0.
decision_rule.inconclusive: All quality guards pass and neither PASS nor FAIL condition holds.
decision_rule.invalid: Any quality guard, join/cardinality, counter invariant, exact binding or evidence-integrity check fails.

raw_preservation_contract.raw_fields: workload identifiers, candidate/dense named counters, total work, output-equivalence observations, and counter invariants

stop_rule: Stop after green readiness at H5_FORMAL_CONTRACT_READY_FOR_ANALYST_REVIEW. Fresh Evidence Analyst authorization is required before identity reservation, STARTED, official TEST, preservation, formal scoring or evidence creation.
